title: Stabilization of monotone control systems with input constraints
summary: We present a stabilizing output-feedback controller for nonlinear finite and infinite-dimensional control systems governed by monotone operators that respects given input constraints. In particular, we show under a detectability-like assumption that a saturated version of the classical output feedback controller in passivity-based control achieves control-constrained stabilization as long as the control corresponding to the desired equilibrium is in the interior of the control constraint set.
